title: Profile
description: A user's account and global context — used to log in, and to re-project IR entries into a personalized view. Global per user, not scoped to any one project. password_hash is stored here but must never be included in any API response.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for login. Backend-only — strip before returning a profile from any endpoint.

content.description: Free-form self-description: role, expertise, history blurb, whatever re-projection needs. Starts empty at signup; the user fills it in and can edit it any time from the app. Shape isn't fixed by separate fields.
